title: Evacuation of surrounding Jewish communities
summary: On November 2, 1942, the vicinity around Bialystok containing approximately 150,000 Jews was evacuated; people were murdered in their home communities or sent to Treblinka.
uncertaintyNote: The text does not identify a single destination or event participant beyond the affected Jews.
